==Variables==
*display &ndash; Used to override the automatic template display behavior
*param &ndash; Used to add parameters
*width &ndash; Used to modify the template's width.
*subst &ndash; When assigned a value, the 'subst' modifier is added
*cat &ndash; Used to link to the category that the template places pages in
*morecat &ndash; Used to list additional categories.
